Starlink is turning its satellite dish network into micro-metered access points. The company is recruiting third-party site hosts to sell hourly, daily, and weekly network passes to local users. The hardware, billing integration, access control, and backhaul stay inside Starlink's stack; the host simply provisions physical space, keeps the terminal powered, and takes a revenue cut.

For network engineers running edge deployments in remote territory, this shifts low Earth orbit satellite terminals from dedicated corporate overhead into on-demand, self-funding infrastructure. Instead of locking remote industrial, maritime, or rural facilities into fixed monthly service subscriptions, local operators can monetize transient field workers and visitors without administering captive portals or handling card transactions.

Behind that network layer sits an explosive, escalating demand for compute and energy. From $60 billion silicon debt syndicates to deep-well geothermal plants coming online ahead of schedule, the physical footprint of computing is restructuring faster than the software sitting on top of it.

> Wall Street is assembling a $60 billion debt deal to fund dedicated silicon lines at Broadcom for Anthropic, with an initial $42 billion senior-secured tranche.

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/nynVYVzBMLgC12PcmQtHUA/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdGFybGluay10dXJucy1oYXJkd2FyZS1ob3N0cy1pbnRvLWRlY2VudHJhbGl6ZWQtbWljcm8taXNwc3x8aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGNtYWcuY29tL25ld3Mvc3RhcmxpbmstY29tbXVuaXR5LXNpdGUtcHJvZ3JhbS10ZWFzZXMtaG91cmx5LXdlZWtseS1pbnRlcm5ldC1wYXNzZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: pcmag.com ↗</a></p>

Starlink's [Community Site program](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/nynVYVzBMLgC12PcmQtHUA/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdGFybGluay10dXJucy1oYXJkd2FyZS1ob3N0cy1pbnRvLWRlY2VudHJhbGl6ZWQtbWljcm8taXNwc3x8aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGNtYWcuY29tL25ld3Mvc3RhcmxpbmstY29tbXVuaXR5LXNpdGUtcHJvZ3JhbS10ZWFzZXMtaG91cmx5LXdlZWtseS1pbnRlcm5ldC1wYXNzZXM_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t) treats satellite terminals like headless micro-ISPs. The host takes on power provisioning, physical security, and local line-of-sight logistics, while Starlink manages subscriber authentication, captive-portal isolation, rate limits, and payment processing.

Pricing tiers remain unpublished, but the operational model targets transient populations that cannot commit to flat monthly fees. For operations teams running remote sites, this eliminates the administrative friction of sharing corporate LANs with contractors or managing local billing gateways. If Starlink handles the captive network slice end-to-end, field deployments gain zero-overhead connectivity that funds its own operating expenditure.

<h2 id="custom-silicon-goes-leveraged-broadcom-targets-60b-for-anthropic"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress._" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Custom silicon goes leveraged: Broadcom targets $60B for Anthropic</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress._" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: bloomberg.com ↗</a></p>

A Wall Street debt syndicate led by Blackstone is putting together a [$60 billion financing package for Broadcom](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress._) to build custom ASIC pipelines for Anthropic and select infrastructure partners. Lenders are already circulating term sheets for an initial $42 billion Class A senior-secured tranche.

This shifts frontier model scaling into the realm of mega-scale leveraged infrastructure. Custom ASIC development at TSMC nodes requires massive multi-year capital commitments that balance sheets cannot absorb through venture rounds alone. To break NVIDIA's margin stranglehold, model developers are using investment-grade structured debt to lock down dedicated foundry allocations and packaging supply years in advance.

<h2 id="deep-well-geothermal-hits-commercial-delivery-in-23-months"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Deep-well geothermal hits commercial delivery in 23 months</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: techcrunch.com ↗</a></p>

Fervo Energy brought the first commercial block of its [Cape Station enhanced geothermal project](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.) online in Beaver County, Utah, synchronizing with the grid in 23 months - one day ahead of its deadline. This marks the first operational third of a 100 MW phase within a facility engineered to scale to 4 GW using horizontal drilling and hydraulic stimulation techniques borrowed from the oil and gas sector.

Data center site selectors have run into hard transmission queues and intermittent renewable limits. Geothermal provides baseload, round-the-clock power with capacity factors above 90%, avoiding the battery storage overhead required by solar and wind. With hyperscalers like Google buying early output, Cape Station proves that deep-rock geothermal generation can be permitted, drilled, and tied to transmission lines within typical compute hardware delivery timelines. Fervo now expects subsequent blocks to deploy in 18 months.

<h2 id="nasa-locks-in-prima-to-bridge-the-space-observatory-gap"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">NASA locks in PRIMA to bridge the space observatory gap</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: arstechnica.com ↗</a></p>

NASA has selected the [PRIMA infrared observatory](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.) as its inaugural Probe Explorer mission, targeting launch in 2033 under the Jet Propulsion Laboratory. The competing AXIS X-ray telescope was dropped after budget and management overruns surfaced at Goddard Space Flight Center, leaving PRIMA as the sole project advancing to Phase B.

PRIMA addresses the gap between inexpensive, high-cadence Explorer satellites and multi-decade, ten-figure flagships like JWST. Carrying a cryogenic telescope sensitive to far-infrared wavelengths between 24 and 235 micrometers, it investigates interstellar gas, water formation, and early galactic evolution - spectral bands blocked by Earth's atmosphere. For aerospace systems engineers, the program formalizes a $1 billion cost cap designed to enforce predictable delivery cycles on complex orbital platforms.

<h2 id="37signals-abandons-manual-coding-as-standard-practice"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">37signals abandons manual coding as standard practice</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress." target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: blog.pragmaticengineer.com ↗</a></p>

At Rails World, David Heinemeier Hansson stated that [37signals no longer writes code by hand](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.) as regular operating practice. Manual syntax composition is now categorized inside the company as a failure state or an exception. Heinemeier Hansson dated the shift to November 24, 2025, tracking the release of Anthropic's Opus 4.5.

Coming from a software studio historically stubborn about manual craft and small engineering teams, the change matters. Development pipelines at 37signals now operate as agent-orchestrated environments where engineers act as system prompters, architectural boundary guards, and code review harnesses. Production development is decoupling from mechanical syntax emission: high-context reasoning models make typing out boilerplate, framework glue, and test harnesses an operational inefficiency.

<h2 id="surviving-runtime-agent-panics-with-pi-durable-and-transcript-pipelines"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/8z-GjYONUgfF96-0gku9RQ/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdXJ2aXZpbmctcnVudGltZS1hZ2VudC1wYW5pY3Mtd2l0aC1waS1kdXJhYmxlLWFuZC10cmFuc2NyaXB0LXBpcGVsaW5lc3x8aHR0cHM6Ly9lYXJlbmRpbC5jb20vcG9zdHMvcGktZHVyYWJsZS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Surviving runtime agent panics with Pi Durable and transcript pipelines</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/8z-GjYONUgfF96-0gku9RQ/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdXJ2aXZpbmctcnVudGltZS1hZ2VudC1wYW5pY3Mtd2l0aC1waS1kdXJhYmxlLWFuZC10cmFuc2NyaXB0LXBpcGVsaW5lc3x8aHR0cHM6Ly9lYXJlbmRpbC5jb20vcG9zdHMvcGktZHVyYWJsZS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: earendil.com ↗</a></p>

Earendil launched Pi 1.0 alongside [Pi Durable](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/8z-GjYONUgfF96-0gku9RQ/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdXJ2aXZpbmctcnVudGltZS1hZ2VudC1wYW5pY3Mtd2l0aC1waS1kdXJhYmxlLWFuZC10cmFuc2NyaXB0LXBpcGVsaW5lc3x8aHR0cHM6Ly9lYXJlbmRpbC5jb20vcG9zdHMvcGktZHVyYWJsZS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t), a harness built to solve the failure states common to agent execution: context exhaustion, process exits, and broken API calls. Pi Durable provides persistent external state backends, multi-human steering interfaces, and isolated execution sandboxes across local hosts, remote VMs, and in-memory containers. It allows long-horizon agents to resume state cleanly following machine crashes or context-window boundaries.

Alongside runtime durability, teams are hardening their data tier. Quesma published [Quesma Shipper](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/Fw31XgNVuKtZevnH0SneKg/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdXJ2aXZpbmctcnVudGltZS1hZ2VudC1wYW5pY3Mtd2l0aC1waS1kdXJhYmxlLWFuZC10cmFuc2NyaXB0LXBpcGVsaW5lc3x8aHR0cHM6Ly9xdWVzbWEuY29tL2Jsb2cvYWdlbnQtc2Vzc2lvbi10cmFuc2NyaXB0cy1hcmUtcHJlY2lvdXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YnJpZWYtdGVjaC1uZXdzLmNvbQ), an open-source telemetry forwarder that dumps interaction logs, tool invocations, and raw tokens from agents like Claude Code and Cursor into enterprise S3 buckets. Instead of letting execution traces vanish into ephemeral IDE memory, engineering teams are storing these trajectories as audit records, cost controls, and internal datasets for downstream distillation.

<h2 id="aurora-postgresql-embeds-duckdb-for-direct-iceberg-querying"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/xDtTcT8tekGNQNqi__dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Aurora PostgreSQL embeds DuckDB for direct Iceberg querying</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/xDtTcT8tekGNQNqi__dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: aws.amazon.com ↗</a></p>

Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now supports [native direct queries on Apache Iceberg and Parquet formats](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/xDtTcT8tekGNQNqi__dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1icmllZi10ZWNoLW5ld3MuY29t) residing in S3 and S3 Tables via the Iceberg REST Catalog. AWS accomplished this by embedding an vectorized DuckDB execution engine straight into the Aurora PostgreSQL runtime process.

This changes data architectures that rely on brittle reverse-ETL pipelines to reconcile analytics data with operational OLTP records. Backend engineers can now join live relational rows with multi-terabyte analytical lakehouse partitions in standard PostgreSQL syntax. The query executes locally against external S3 storage without moving files into PostgreSQL heap tables or paying the network overhead of third-party federated query engines.

<h2 id="conversational-wrappers-model-routing-and-the-bitter-lesson"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/gsxGHNSHW3J48ARg5WLwaQ/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxjb252ZXJzYXRpb25hbC13cmFwcGVycy1tb2RlbC1yb3V0aW5nLWFuZC10aGUtYml0dGVyLWxlc3Nvbnx8aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub25ldXNlZnVsdGhpbmcub3JnL3AvdGhlLWRvdC1hbmQtdGhlLXN3YXJtP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YnJpZWYtdGVjaC1uZXdzLmNvbQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Conversational wrappers, model routing, and the Bitter Lesson</a></h2>

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/gsxGHNSHW3J48ARg5WLwaQ/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxjb252ZXJzYXRpb25hbC13cmFwcGVycy1tb2RlbC1yb3V0aW5nLWFuZC10aGUtYml0dGVyLWxlc3Nvbnx8aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub25ldXNlZnVsdGhpbmcub3JnL3AvdGhlLWRvdC1hbmQtdGhlLXN3YXJtP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YnJpZWYtdGVjaC1uZXdzLmNvbQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: oneusefulthing.org ↗</a></p>

Ethan Mollick argued in [The Dot and the Swarm](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/gsxGHNSHW3J48ARg5WLwaQ/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxjb252ZXJzYXRpb25hbC13cmFwcGVycy1tb2RlbC1yb3V0aW5nLWFuZC10aGUtYml0dGVyLWxlc3Nvbnx8aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub25ldXNlZnVsdGhpbmcub3JnL3AvdGhlLWRvdC1hbmQtdGhlLXN3YXJtP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YnJpZWYtdGVjaC1uZXdzLmNvbQ) that brute-force model capability leaps continue to obsolete complex human-designed orchestration scaffolds. Frontier systems like Opus 5.5, OpenAI dots, and Gemini Spark increasingly manage step planning and error self-correction without needing brittle prompting templates. The "Bitter Lesson" is hitting AI engineering: building complex state machines around models often costs more than waiting for the next weights release to solve the routing natively.

Where lightweight intervention is still needed, specialized models are getting cheaper. Cloudflare launched [Clef and Clef-flash](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/U255uQxQKewVpPGrV_76SA/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxjb252ZXJzYXRpb25hbC13cmFwcGVycy1tb2RlbC1yb3V0aW5nLWFuZC10aGUtYml0dGVyLWxlc3Nvbnx8aHR0cHM6Ly9ibG9nLmNsb3VkZmxhcmUuY29tL2NsZWYtZGVjaXNpb24tbW9kZWxzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWJyaWVmLXRlY2gtbmV3cy5jb20), an Apache-2.0 decision-model pair accessible via Workers AI and compatible with the Jev API. Rather than wasting wide-parameter models on classification, Clef outputs deterministic, structured JSON tokens for control flow and routing at high throughput and low cost.

Concurrently, vertical consumer apps are building direct headless conversational pipes to defend their margins. DoorDash's [20,000-user iMessage pilot](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/XISDd6fTQD977xTiN895Eg/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxjb252ZXJzYXRpb25hbC13cmFwcGVycy1tb2RlbC1yb3V0aW5nLWFuZC10aGUtYml0dGVyLWxlc3Nvbnx8aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubWJpLWRlZXBkaXZlcy5jb20vbm8tYWRzLW11c2UvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9YnJpZWYtdGVjaC1uZXdzLmNvbQ) proved that in-app text agents generated roughly 50% larger shopping baskets than classic app navigation, while unassisted traffic from horizontal assistants like Meta's Muse yielded orders two-thirds smaller. Vertical platforms that guard their transactional graphs can monetize conversational flow directly, whereas horizontal agents must lean on downstream ad attribution across surfaces like Instagram to monetize assistance.

<p class="small mb-4"><a href="https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/zlHGnS6NSLRDseHQd3VIag/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdGFibGVjb2lucy14Ym94LXNjYWxlLWFuZC1hcnhpdnMtYWktdGhyb3R0bGV8fGh0dHBzOi8vbG9tYmFyZG5vdGVzLnh5ei8yMDI2LzEwLzAxL3RoZS1pbmV2aXRhYmlsaXR5LW9mLWxvY2FsLXN0YWJsZWNvaW5zLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWJyaWVmLXRlY2gtbmV3cy5jb20" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source: lombardnotes.xyz ↗</a></p>

Non-USD stablecoins grew their aggregate supply [from $379 million to $1.6 billion over the last 20 months](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/zlHGnS6NSLRDseHQd3VIag/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdGFibGVjb2lucy14Ym94LXNjYWxlLWFuZC1hcnhpdnMtYWktdGhyb3R0bGV8fGh0dHBzOi8vbG9tYmFyZG5vdGVzLnh5ei8yMDI2LzEwLzAxL3RoZS1pbmV2aXRhYmlsaXR5LW9mLWxvY2FsLXN0YWJsZWNvaW5zLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWJyaWVmLXRlY2gtbmV3cy5jb20), with transfer volumes jumping 16x despite USD tokens commanding over 99% of total stablecoin capitalization. Roughly 80% of EURC and related local-currency token throughput is tied to organic B2B invoices, remittances, and corporate treasury management, decoupling settlement networks from speculative crypto exchanges.

In gaming, Microsoft Xbox CEO Asha Sharma outlined a structural pivot toward [cloud-streamed hardware and cross-platform ecosystems](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/U7NFrA_nIiAOXZLi-) to capture players across Latin America, Africa, and South Asia. The strategy leans away from traditional console update cycles, reinvesting in Minecraft to counter user-generated content engines like Roblox.

Finally, arXiv instituted a [hard rate-limit policy](https://ecommerce-api.datafortress.cloud/r/brieftechnews/XeZjnJXb4EsblP1SX0vzQg/djF8d2VifDIwMjYtMTAtMDItdGVjaHxzdGFibGVjb2lucy14Ym94LXNjYWxlLWFuZC1hcnhpdnMtYWktdGhyb3R0bGV8fGh0dHBzOi8vYmxvZy5hcnhpdi5vcmcvMjAyNi8xMC8wMS91cGRhdGVkLXJhdGUtbGltaXQtcG9saWN5Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWJyaWVmLXRlY2gtbmV3cy5jb20) capping individual submitters at two papers per calendar month and three active reviews at any time. Monthly submissions jumped from 20,569 in September 2024 to 40,363 in September 2026, generating 9,000 open support tickets and breaking volunteer moderation systems with automated, synthetic manuscript submissions.
